# wgpu-native - vendored prebuilt WebGPU implementation

The `webgpu.h` headers and the prebuilt libraries of wgpu-native
(https://github.com/gfx-rs/wgpu-native), release `VERSION`. The native WebGPU backend loads the
library at run time; a player ships it beside the executable.
